name: logos-blockchain-node.public.dappnode.eth
description: **Community-maintained, UNOFFICIAL** Logos blockchain node — not an official Logos release. Headless Logos 0.3.0 testnet node: generates a fresh config + keys on first run (IBD peers filled), persists chain state to a volume, and runs PoW mining capped to 1 thread with auto-claim. Mining threads, mining on/off, and log level are configurable in the setup wizard. A bundled **web dashboard** (the UI button) replicates the official Logos node app: node status, rewards, explorer, wallet, mining, and settings. A bundled Prometheus exporter feeds the DAppNode monitoring stack (DMS) a ready-made Grafana dashboard. Testnet is ephemeral (re-genesises each release). For the official package, watch for a signed release in the curated DAppStore.
gettingStarted:
## Logos node (community, unofficial)

This runs a headless **Logos 0.3.0 testnet** node. On first start it generates a fresh config + keys, fills the IBD peers, and begins syncing. PoW mining is **on by default, capped to 1 CPU thread** (so it won't peg the host) with auto-claim.

**Open the dashboard** — click **UI** to open the bundled web dashboard: node status, rewards, explorer, wallet, and mining.

**Check it's working** — the dashboard's Node tab should read **Online / Following the chain**, with a rising Height and more than zero peers. A Grafana dashboard is auto-provisioned in **DMS** (`http://dms.dappnode`).

**Blend** — if you run Blend, forward **UDP 3400** to this node so peers can reach it.

**Config, keystore, and database** live with the container — manage them from this package's **Config**, **Backup**, and **File Manager** tabs. Back up your keystore: it is the one file that cannot be regenerated.

_Testnet is ephemeral and re-genesises on releases. Unofficial and community-maintained; for the official package, watch for a signed release in the curated DAppStore._
